source: Notion Templates DB, collection://3e8c931f-6ae5-8071-98a0-000befdd6354, snapshot 2026-10-11 (paused state, IRDR-482)
note: Reply texts are the Notion templates verbatim (placeholders in [brackets]). 'Research in Stripe/Supabase/Vercel' and 'Search knowledge base' describe research, not executable actions.

templates.name: Cancellation only
templates.trigger: Customer wants to cancel their subscription and does not ask for a refund, also when they ask to cancel immediately. Cancel at the end of the paid period, never immediately. No confirmation needed and no refund. Do not ask why they cancel. If they ask for money back, use Refund request (latest payment).
templates.reply:
Hi, thanks for reaching out!

I've cancelled your subscription. It ends at the end of your current billing period and will not renew, so you will not be charged again. Until then it stays paused, because InstaRadar is currently paused.

When your subscription ends, the data saved in your account will be deleted, most importantly your saved tracking activity for [profile]. If InstaRadar comes back, you can get your data back.

If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

Best regards,
Anastasia
InstaRadar Support

templates.name: Cancellation + reason ask
templates.trigger: Not a separate case while the service is paused. Do not ask customers why they cancel. Handle exactly like Cancellation only: cancel at the end of the paid period, no confirmation, no refund.
templates.reply:
Hi, thanks for reaching out!

I've cancelled your subscription. It ends at the end of your current billing period and will not renew, so you will not be charged again. Until then it stays paused, because InstaRadar is currently paused.

When your subscription ends, the data saved in your account will be deleted, most importantly your saved tracking activity for [profile]. If InstaRadar comes back, you can get your data back.

If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

Best regards,
Anastasia
InstaRadar Support

templates.name: Refund request (latest payment)
templates.trigger: Customer asks for a refund or their money back for a payment made before October 5, 2026. First request: offer only the unused part of the latest payment before October 5 (prorated, see Rules) and say clearly that it is a partial refund. Exception: if the customer explicitly refers to our refund policy, the money-back guarantee or the terms on our website, offer the full refund of that payment right away. Every refund here ends the subscription immediately and the customer's saved data will be deleted even though InstaRadar is down (they can get it back if InstaRadar comes back), so it always needs their confirmation first. If the customer answers the partial offer by asking for the full amount, refund in full and cancel, that reply counts as their confirmation. If the subscription is already cancelled, skip the confirmation and refund right away. For a charge made on or after October 5 use Charged after cancellation attempt.
templates.reply:
Hi, thanks for reaching out!

InstaRadar is currently paused. There is an issue with our access to Instagram data, and it is outside of our control. We are working on it, but we cannot say yet whether or when InstaRadar will be back. Your subscription has been paused, and you will not be charged while InstaRadar is down.

[First request: I can give you a partial refund for the part of your last payment that you could not use: [prorated amount] of your [amount] payment from [date]. That covers the time from October 5, when InstaRadar went down, until the end of your billing period on [period end date]. / Customer refers to our refund policy: I can refund your [amount] payment from [date] in full.]

One important note first: a refund ends your subscription immediately, and even though InstaRadar is down, the data saved in your account will be deleted, most importantly your saved tracking activity for [profile]. If InstaRadar comes back, you can get your data back. If you would rather keep everything as it is, you can simply stay subscribed. It costs nothing while InstaRadar is down.

Just reply to confirm and I'll process the refund straight away. The money then shows up on your statement within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank.

Best regards,
Anastasia
InstaRadar Support

templates.name: Cancellation + refund + account deletion
templates.trigger: Customer wants to cancel, get a refund and have their account deleted. Handle the refund and cancellation like Refund request (latest payment): partial refund first, or the full refund right away if the customer refers to our refund policy, and always confirmation first. The deletion part is high risk and Phillip decides. Never delete anything yourself, never say that data has already been deleted, and do not propose Delete account.
templates.reply:

[First request: I can cancel your subscription and give you a partial refund for the part of your last payment that you could not use: [prorated amount] of your [amount] payment from [date]. That covers the time from October 5, when InstaRadar went down, until the end of your billing period on [period end date]. / Customer refers to our refund policy: I can cancel your subscription and refund your [amount] payment from [date] in full.]

One important note first: this ends your subscription immediately, and even though InstaRadar is down, the data saved in your account will be deleted, most importantly your saved tracking activity for [profile].

Just reply to confirm and I'll process it straight away. The money then shows up on your statement within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. I've also passed on your request about your account, and you will hear back from us by email about it.

templates.name: Account deletion request
templates.trigger: Customer asks to delete or terminate their account or their data. Always high risk: Phillip decides. Send only this short holding reply. Never delete anything yourself, never say that data has already been deleted, and do not propose Delete account or a cancellation.

Refund the remaining amount of that same payment so it is refunded in full. No reason needed while the service is paused, no confirmation needed, no discussion.

I am sorry again for the trouble, and thank you for having been with InstaRadar.

Best regards,
Anastasia
InstaRadar Support

templates.name: Charged after cancellation attempt
templates.trigger: Customer asks why they were charged although InstaRadar is down, wants a refund for a charge made on or after October 5, 2026, or was charged after cancelling. Every charge made on or after October 5, 2026 is refunded in full. Check that exact charge in Stripe first: if it is already refunded in full, name the refund date. If it is partly refunded or not refunded yet, refund the remaining amount so the charge is refunded in full. No confirmation, no cancellation. A charge from before October 5 follows Refund request (latest payment) instead.
